## What needs review?

Explain whether the position appears active, inactive, carrier-only, or misregistered, and why.

## Cell context

Include the `(row,column)` coordinate, matching glyph IDs, relevant frame references, and any audit result. The explorer's report link fills these in automatically.

## Supporting evidence

Link to permitted evidence or describe the exact source/video/frame checks used. Do not upload copyrighted source video unless you have permission.
